verdict.rationale: A live probe found Qodo's docs serve an llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a descriptive product overview, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The docs also include agent-facing material for the Agentic Toolbox, with integration guides for Claude Code, Codex, Kiro, the CLI and MCP. Missing for 10: no evidence of llms-full.txt or per-page markdown/agent-optimized doc variants, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually consume these docs well.
